cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Disclosed at company level; Hong Kong/listed parent cash has a direct distribution or repayment path, with small friction reserve kept separately.
cash_breakdown.reason: Company statement of financial position disclosed US$35.813m cash and cash equivalents at 31 December 2025.

cash_breakdown.item: Parent company bank deposits with original maturity over 3 months
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Bank deposits longer than three months; maturity beyond three months but no restriction disclosed, so treated as detachable with a term-deposit haircut.
cash_breakdown.reason: Company statement of financial position disclosed US$15.355m deposits with original maturity over 3 months.

cash_breakdown.item: Group cash/deposits not held at parent company
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Residual group cash is not split by subsidiary, jurisdiction, operating entity, minority interest or PRC dividend path; manufacturing and logistics operations are mainly in China, so the default group-only cash haircut is conservative.
cash_breakdown.reason: Group cash and deposits with banks were US$190.240m; parent company cash plus deposits were US$51.168m.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Interest-bearing borrowings are deducted at 100%; all were current and fixed-rate. This includes US$10.707m bills discounted with full recourse.
cash_breakdown.reason: Note 34 disclosed US$42.415m unsecured bank loans and US$10.707m bills discounted with recourse.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Reserved roughly one month of cash operating costs plus cyclical working-capital buffer; 2025 operating cash flow was negative and inventories/receivables absorbed cash.
cash_breakdown.reason: Revenue was US$481.544m and cash used in operations before interest/tax was US$36.630m after working-capital movements.

cash_breakdown.item: Tax, FX and dividend friction reserve
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Residual group cash is not fully traced to the listed parent; reserve covers cross-border dividend, withholding tax, FX and extraction friction.
cash_breakdown.reason: No detailed parent/subsidiary cash restriction note was found beyond company-level cash disclosure.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: The asset is an unlisted equity investment, not cash-like and not counted as detachable funds.
cash_breakdown.reason: Note 22 described FVTPL financial asset as investment in an unlisted equity investment.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: The annual report states the investment is held for long-term purposes and is not expected to be sold in the foreseeable future.
cash_breakdown.reason: Note 21 narrative immediately before Note 22 disclosed long-term holding intention for the FVTOCI equity instrument.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Operating leases are part of continuing operations; not mechanically deducted from detachable cash, with lease burden instead reflected in profit/cash conversion.
cash_breakdown.reason: Note 30 disclosed total lease liabilities of US$3.681m.

profit_quality.assessment: Low cash conversion in the current cycle. The 2023-2025 parent-profit median is US$19.438m, but 2025 and 2024 operating cash flow were both negative and 2025 working capital absorbed US$78.760m before interest and tax. The main owner-earnback denominator is therefore the three-year profit median discounted to 30%.
adjustments: Started from 2023-2025 parent net profit median of US$19.438m using five-year financial summary and 2025 comparative profit statement.
Did not add back bank deposit interest income to operating cash profit because part of the cash pile is being deducted from enterprise purchase price.

Recognised non-operating volatility: 2025 had US$7.181m fair-value losses on investment property/PPE transfer, US$2.983m associate/JV results, US$1.051m government grants and US$1.521m expected-credit-loss charge.

Applied a 0.30 profit haircut because net operating cash flow was US$-47.510m in 2025 and US$-61.686m in 2024, while container leasing assets and receivables/inventories required substantial reinvestment.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: 2025 operating cash flow was US$-47.510m; 2024 was US$-61.686m. 2025 cash purchase of PPE plus right-of-use assets was US$22.748m, while note 16 showed US$86.877m of inventory transferred into leased containers.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Cyclical container manufacturing, negative recent operating cash flow, large working-capital absorption and leasing-portfolio reinvestment make only a minority of accounting profit currently distributable.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: Poor in 2025 and 2024; operating cash flow divided by parent net profit was approximately -2.73x in 2025.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: Cash capital spending in 2025 was US$19.851m for PPE and US$2.897m for right-of-use assets; note 16 also shows large leased-container additions from inventory, suggesting reinvestment is not negligible.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: 2025 working-capital movements consumed US$78.760m before interest and tax, mainly inventories, third-party receivables, payables and customer advances.
